description: Live USD prices for the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market cap: rank, name, symbol, price, 1h / 24h / 7d percent change, market cap and 24h volume. Data from CoinGecko, at most about 60 s old. Pass symbols (tickers like "btc", or CoinGecko ids / names like "ethereum") for specific coins, or omit them for the top N by market cap. Coins outside the top 100 are not available.

limit.description: How many coins to return, by market cap rank, when symbols is omitted.

symbols.description: Tickers, CoinGecko ids or names, case-insensitive, e.g. ["btc", "eth", "zcash"]. Omit for the top N.

name: get_crypto_prices
title: Crypto prices (top 100)
